description: Find Florida restaurant establishments in KitchenGrade's captured DBPR records. Returns exact identifiers and independently calculated, dated KitchenGrade inspection grades; not DBPR grades or food-safety guarantees. Empty results explain when filters hide matches and offer separately labeled recovery suggestions. Report which filters would need to change; suggestions do not satisfy the original filters and are not extra primary matches. Only describe suggestions as nearby when nearRequestedCity is true, using the returned proximity qualification. Use an exact establishment ID with get_restaurant_grade before recommending a specific restaurant.

acceptable_only.description: Return only current A+, A, B grades; do not hide other grades when evaluating a supplied restaurant.

city.description: Optional strict recorded-city filter, not a nearby radius. Omit it when searching the broader area; Orlando records do not match Winter Park.

query.description: Restaurant name or public address/city text; no personal data or coordinates. Do not send placeholder searches. Use MCP ping for connection checks.

name: search_restaurants
title: Search KitchenGrade Restaurants
